anne: Quick design critique — playground streaming view. Uploaded mock: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/playground-stream-mock anne: Main asks: where should Stop / Regenerate live when streaming is on? Also token counter visibility and prompt library discoverability. Thoughts? mike: My take: Stop should be primary action during streaming (high emphasis), regen is secondary. Put Stop inline with the stream controls, not buried in the overflow menu. :thumbsup: julia: Agree re: priority. UX question — keep token counter pinned to the conversation header or float near the last message? Floating gets noisy when multiple messages stream. sam: For discoverability, prompt library should have a compact dock button in the rail (left) with keyboard shortcut. I propose `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+P` opens the prompt drawer. Works well for power users. eli: Accessibility nits: when streaming updates new content, screen readers need an `aria-live` region that says "new content streaming" but not announce partial tokens. Also focus must not jump unexpectedly when stop is pressed. Contrast on the stop pill is borderline — need 4.5:1. julia: On the token counter copy: replace "Tokens used" with "Estimated tokens" for streaming to set expectation. Also show both session total and last-response tokens. mike: Visual: token meter thresholds — green < 2k, amber 2k-6k, red > 6k. Let's avoid red for mid-state to reduce alarm. Maybe orange at 6k+. eli: Microcopy for stop button: prefer "Stop" (verb) not "Cancel" (implies undo). For regenerate, "Regenerate response" is clearer than "Retry". sam: Prompt library quick action: add drag-to-canvas so users can drag a prompt into composer. Also allow pinning favorite prompts. anne: Edge case: if user hits Stop mid-stream, we should show a compact "Regenerate" affordance at the message level with server-side resume possibility. If resume isn't supported, show a tooltip "Partial response saved — regenerate to continue". julia: Keyboard focus flow: Tab order should be composer -> send -> stop/regenerate -> token counter -> prompt button. Add visible focus ring to token counter. eli: Proposed aria snippet: `````
````` eli: Note: `aria-atomic=false` avoids re-reading entire content each chunk, reduces verbosity for SR users. mike: A/B idea: Test token counter pinned vs collapsed pill (hover to expand). Metrics: clicks into prompt library, regen rate, time-to-first-interaction. anne: Decisions for this sprint: - Move Stop inline into streaming toolbar (mike) - Token counter pinned to header, show estimate + session total (julia) - Add `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P` to open prompt library + drag-to-canvas (sam) - Accessibility fixes: aria-live change, focus ring, contrast (eli) - Microcopy tweaks: "Stop" and "Regenerate response" (anne) anne: Owners + due: mike (stop placement) EOD +5, julia (token copy & meter) +7, sam (shortcut + drag) +10, eli (accessibility) +4. ui-bot: Deploy note: Design tickets created: #PL-482, #PL-483, #PL-484, #PL-485. PR checklist will include accessibility unit tests. sam: tiny nit — can we show a subtle "streaming" pulsing dot in the header while active? quick mock: https://i.imgur.com/mockimg.png julia: :eyes: love the pulsing dot. ensure color contrast and motion reduced mode respects prefers-reduced-motion. anne: Great — thanks all. I'll consolidate mocks and update the figma page. If no objections, we'll move to implementation next sprint. :rocket:
